Klasse RoundedLineBorder

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.border.AbstractBorder
treptowkolleg.plot.components.RoundedLineBorder
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Serializable, Border
public class RoundedLineBorder extends AbstractBorder
A custom Swing border that renders a rounded rectangle outline with configurable stroke thickness and corner curvature. This border is fully anti-aliased and designed for modern, visually smooth UI elements.

The border insets are automatically calculated based on the line thickness and arc dimensions to ensure proper spacing between the border and contained components. It extends AbstractBorder and integrates seamlessly with standard Swing layout managers.

Typical use cases include framing input fields, panels, or buttons in a cohesive visual language within the treptowkolleg.plot framework.
